issue_request: FHIR-45005 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I R6 change request for FHIR-core Group. It asked to replace the stale Group.characteristic comment that said all characteristics must be true with wording governed by Group.combinationMethod, and to make the absent Group.combinationMethod default explicit as all-of.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied before this reconciliation in commit 191fa02f0491ac1c45c574c4cc95daef019aa472. Although that commit's subject is FHIR-43501, its body lists FHIR-45005 and its patch added the Group.combinationMethod meaningWhenMissing value and changed the Group.characteristic comment to the Jira resolution wording.
additional_context: Group is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini. The current ElementDefinition source uses meaningWhenMissing as the element name for the Jira-described meaningIfMissing/default semantics. FHIR-I minutes for 2024-04-29 record the Persuasive 8-0-0 disposition, and targeted Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion. The combined branch already contained the corrected source and did not yet contain an Issue-Reconcile-Key audit for FHIR-45005.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current source and combined branch already have Group.combinationMethod meaningWhenMissing set to "If absent, this element is treated as though it had been set to 'all-of'" and Group.characteristic set to the combinationMethod-aware comment.
